currency_assumptions: Venue prices are researched and stored in KRW (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = KRW). The soft budget and every USD figure use the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65, giving USD 1 = KRW 1334.9001 and 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the derived cross rate and four hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes a full-day or package rate, that figure is the recorded amount (DDP 11-hour day, 판교 08:00-17:00 day, COCOC 9-hour package, 노들섬 weekend day, 마로니에 8-hour block sum). Where only an hourly rate exists, the recorded amount is that rate multiplied by 8 hours and the record carries cost_basis estimated_from_rate with estimated_hours 8 and a final-quote question (COCOC 컨퍼런스룸 A, 몽상가들 서브 세미나룸, 마로니에공원 다목적홀). Where no readable price exists, estimated_cost_usd is null with a cost_unknown question (COEX rooms, KT&G 상상마당, 스페이스쉐어, 성공 스페이스).

declared_gaps.text: School holidays for Seoul are not in the pinned registry: the installed Asia edition 3b20667d… lists KR:seoul as a curated host but carries no KR:seoul holiday row and no KR:seoul coverage row, so no school row is stored and the Seoul calendar layer carries public holidays only (20 KR rows from the 2027 월력요항). Seoul school dates are published per school through NEIS, one school year at a time; no 2027 Seoul-wide vacation calendar was found at 2026-11-28 (the 서울특별시교육청 index served a NetFunnel queue shell and its notice list returned no 학사일정 page). The dated, scoped finding is recorded in the store's coverage rows; no Osaka, Tokyo or Kyoto school row was substituted.

The three local-requirement claims record Seoul's language channels, the national alcohol licensing route and Seoul's food-service permit route. None of them says which licence a given venue holds, whether a 50-person private event is covered, or who would hold it: alcohol service and external catering stay unknown on every room. Two captured venue pages do address it — the DDP organiser guide requires prior approval for food and prior discussion for any alcohol brought in, and 몽상가들 스페이스 states that food and alcohol brought in need separate consultation — but neither says who holds a licence.

Six of the sixteen rooms carry operator-published room photographs (12 hotlinked images: DDP 서울-온 화상스튜디오 ×3, COEX 스튜디오 159 ×3, 마로니에공원 다목적홀 ×1, 노들섬 라이브하우스 ×3, 노들섬 노들라운지 ×1, KT&G 상상마당 라이브홀 ×1); ten keep an explicit withheld record with the reason (DDP 디자인홀, DDP 잔디사랑방, COEX 컨퍼런스룸 300, 판교 대회의실, 판교 국제회의장, 몽상가들 서브 세미나룸, 스페이스쉐어 컨퍼런스 B룸, 성공 스페이스, and COCOC 대강당 + 컨퍼런스룸 A, whose published photographs returned 200 at first check and 403 from the operator host on recheck). No Wikimedia image was used: no Commons file on a captured page depicts one of these hired rooms. The 공유누리 hall photograph is published only at 349x262 and is recorded at that size, not upscaled.

Sixteen records sit on ten distinct points. Eight records tier building (DDP ×3, 판교 ×2, 노들섬 라이브하우스, 상상마당 빌딩, 대화빌딩), seven tier street (COCOC ×2 on the 강남대로53길 way, COEX ×2 on a 513 영동대로 point that resolves to a restaurant at that address, 몽상가들 on 8 문래북로, 노들섬 노들라운지 on the island address, 성공 스페이스 on the 왕십리로 way) and 마로니에공원 다목적홀 is area tier (the park). 성공 스페이스 stays a road-segment point after seven Nominatim and four Overpass lookups, all stored. No room entrance was verified anywhere.

Seven 2027 calendar rows were merged from the approved bundle; the page recommends no date and none is booked. KBW2027, UDC, Korea Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fashion Week 2027 F/W and an ETH Seoul 2027 edition have no announced date, so they are carried as notes rather than rows. Three of the seven rows are AI-relevant (AI EXPO KOREA 2027, AI Summit Seoul & Expo 2027, Physical AI EXPO KOREA 2027 at Songdo); the rest are city events used as collision context.

Five of the sixteen records carry no readable price (COEX 컨퍼런스룸 300, COEX 스튜디오 159, KT&G 상상마당 라이브홀, 스페이스쉐어 컨퍼런스 B룸, 성공 스페이스) and their cost is unknown rather than zero; three more record an eight-hour estimate from an hourly rate. USD figures use ECB 2026-11-27 (1 KRW = USD 0.00074912).

The five programme-wide mandatory discovery sources (Miragather ×3, AI Tinkerers, the DeAI Luma feed) carry no check date in this store: the Seoul research bundle recorded no pass against them, and the page prints that fact rather than an assumed read.

evidence.observed_facts: Appendix A closes all primary schools on Thursday 18 and Friday 19 February 2027 and all post-primary schools from Monday 15 to Friday 19 February 2027. Primary schools may use three discretionary days to extend the break to 15-19 February 2027, so only the two days on which every school closes are recorded as the standardised common break.

holidays.source_edition: Circular 0018/2026, Appendix A (2026/27)
holidays.source_locator: Appendix A, 'School Year 2026/27', 'February 2027 mid-term break': 'All primary schools will close on Thursday 18 February 2027 and Friday 19 February 2027.' and 'Post-primary schools will close from Monday 15 February 2027 to Friday 19 February 2027 inclusive unless changes are required as part of contingency arrangements to make up for time lost due to unforeseen school closures.'
holidays.source_title: Circular 0018/2026 - Standardisation of the school year 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29

evidence.inference: The last school day is 19 March 2027 and schools re-open on 5 April 2027, so the break runs from 20 March to 4 April 2027 inclusive.

evidence.observed_facts: The WRC page states 'In Ireland there are ten public holidays each year' and lists the ten holidays by statutory rule; it prints a dated table only for 2026, so this occurrence is the rule-determined date (1 January 2027 is a Friday). The page also states that where a public holiday falls on a day that is not a normal working day there is no legal entitlement to have the next working day off work, so the nominal date is recorded and no substitute date is added.

holidays.source_edition: WRC statutory public holiday list (Organisation of Working Time Act 1997), page read on 2026-11-20
holidays.source_locator: 'Public holidays are:' list, entries 'New Year's Day (1st January)'; 1 January 2027 is a Friday.
holidays.source_title: Public Holidays - Workplace Relations Commission

The optional 23 December extension applies only when 23 December is a Monday (it is a Thursday in 2027), and no ordinance declaring 23 December 2027 or 7 January 2028 free is published, so the statutory span is recorded. The Vienna 2027/28 school-year edition is not published, so this row rests on the statute alone.

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 2 declares 'der Allerseelentag' school-free, and the BMB page lists 'der Allerseelentag (2. November)' under 'Schulfrei sind - abgesehen von den Sonntagen -'. The date is fixed at 2 November in every year, so the 2027 occurrence is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Allerseelen is not one of Austria's statutory public holidays (the AT public layer carries the thirteen gesetzliche Feiertage and none falls on 2 November), so the day is recorded here as a school_holiday row. The Vienna directorate 2026/2027 page lists the same date in its 'Schulfreie Tage' section for 2026 ('Allerheiligen, Allerseelen: Sonntag, 1. November und Montag, 2. November 2026'), confirming that Vienna observes it. Direct access to ris.bka.gv.at from the curation host answers HTTP 503, so the wording was read through the search backend's fetch of the consolidated page https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10009575. That page's 'Fassung vom' header label was not stable across fetches on 2026-11-20 (21.10.2026, 18.11.2026 and 19.11.2026 were each printed by a fetch of the same URL), so this row cites the statute by Gesetzesnummer and asserts no Fassung date.

evidence.observed_facts: The school-year regulation fixes the winter Christmas break as 23–31 December in every year, with an earlier 22 December start only when 22 December is a Monday. In 2027/28 22 December is a Wednesday, so the statutory span is Thursday 23 December to Friday 31 December 2027. The full MEN 2027/2028 calendar is not published; the only 2027/2028 item on the ministry's calendar index is the winter-break announcement, which places mazowieckie on 31 January–13 February 2028, outside this window.

The row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. Vyhláška 16/2005 Sb. § 4 odst. 3 fixes the break as 23 December to 2 January inclusive with an end extension only when 3 January is a Friday; in 2026/27 2 January is a Saturday, so the ministry's stated Sunday end adds only the weekend day on which no teaching takes place.

alcohol.quote: 제5조(주류 판매업면허) ① 주류 판매업(판매중개업 또는 접객업을 포함한다. 이하 같다)을 하려는 자는 대통령령 으로 정하는 주류 판매업의 종류별로 판매장마다 대통령령 으로 정하는 시설기준과 그 밖의 요건을 갖추어 관할 세무서장의 면허를 받아야 한다. ② 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자가 대통령령 으로 정하는 바에 따라 관할 세무서장에게 주류 판매에 관한 신고를 한 경우에는 제1항에 따른 주류 판매업의 면허(이하 “주류 판매업면허”라 한다)를 받은 것으로 본다. 1. 「식품위생법」 에 따른 영업허가를 받은 장소에서 주류 판매업을 하는 자

alcohol.source_title: 「주류 면허 등에 관한 법률」 제5조(주류 판매업면허) [시행 2026. 7. 1.] [법률 제21716호, 2026. 6. 2., 일부개정] — 국가법령정보센터

value.alcohol_at_food_premises: 국세청 prints that among 식품접객업 only 일반음식점, 단란주점 and 유흥주점 may serve alcohol; 휴게음식점 and 위탁급식 cannot hold the 유흥음식점 deemed licence. A hired hall is not itself a licensed 영업장, so whether the venue's own food licence reaches the room is a per-venue question these pages do not answer.
value.authority: 국세청 (the licence is granted and administered by 관할 세무서장 under 「주류 면허 등에 관한 법률」 제5조, 시행 2026-07-01; the 국세청 주류면허 신청 가이드북 restates the deemed route and the 식품접객업 categories)
value.competent_desk: The competent desk is the competent tax office (관할 세무서장) for the venue address, to be confirmed. The captured pages print no district-to-office table, so this claim assigns no ward, district or venue to any particular 세무서.
value.deemed_route_scope: 국세청 prints that the deemed route is opened by a 「식품위생법」 영업허가 place selling alcohol — the 유흥음식점 route — and by a shop of the 백화점·슈퍼마켓·편의점 kind for 일반소매; a food business whose category does not allow drinking cannot use the 유흥음식점 route.
value.licensing_route: Selling alcohol is 주류 판매업 (the law includes 판매중개업 and 접객업 in that term): a person who wants to carry it on must hold a 주류 판매업면허 for the licence type and for each 판매장, granted by 관할 세무서장. Where the place already holds a 「식품위생법」 영업허가 and sells alcohol there, a 신고 to 관할 세무서장 deems the licence granted (주류 판매업면허의 의제).
value.not_established: These pages do not say who holds the licence for a private event in a hired hall, whether complimentary drinks with no sale fall under 주류 판매업, whether a hired hall can be a 판매장, what the fee and lead time are, or whether a hotel's or caterer's existing licence covers a hired room.
value.who_must_hold_it: The holder is the party carrying on the 주류 판매업 at the 판매장 — in the authority's words, '주류 판매업을 하려는 자' or the 「식품위생법」 영업허가 holder that sells there. Which party that is for a 50-person private event (the venue's own F&B operation, an external caterer, or the organiser) is not settled by these pages and must be fixed in the venue contract.

value.alcohol_with_meals: The same table prints 일반음식점영업 as 음식류 조리·판매 with '식사와 함께 부수적인 음주행위 가능', while 휴게음식점영업 and 제과점영업 print '음주행위 불가' — the food category, not the room, decides whether drinking is allowed on the premises.
value.authority: 서울특별시 시민건강국 식품정책과 (담당부서 and 문의 printed on the page); the permit counter is 구청(위생담당 부서)
value.event_route: Not established by this page: it publishes only the fixed-premises 영업허가/영업신고 route for a licensed 식품접객업 premises and says nothing about a 기간제 or 임시 licence for a one-off event, so no event-food route is asserted for Seoul.
value.fixed_premises: The city prints that 식품접객업 splits into 허가업종 (단란주점업, 유흥주점업) and 신고업종 (휴게·일반음식점, 제과점), that the 처리기관 is 구청(위생담당 부서), that a 허가 is handled in 3 days and a 영업신고 in 3 hours, and it prints the 허가 procedure as 신청서 작성 → 접수 → 서류검토 → 현장실사 및 시설조사 → 결재 → 허가증 교부.
value.licence: 「식품위생법」에 따른 식품접객업 영업허가 (단란주점업·유흥주점업) 또는 영업신고 (휴게·일반음식점, 제과점)
value.not_established: The page does not say who holds the licence for a private event (caterer, venue kitchen or organiser), whether a member-only event with no sale needs any notification, what the fee is, or whether a hotel's or venue kitchen's licence covers catering into a hired room; those stay venue-level questions.

language.source_title: 120다산콜 영어 문자상담 시작…다국어 맞춤 서비스 확대! (내 손안에 서울, 서울특별시, 2026-11-05)

value.authority: 서울특별시 (내 손안에 서울, the city's own newsroom, 2026-11-05); the service is run by 서울시 120다산콜재단
value.city_guidance: Seoul publishes official information for non-Korean speakers through named channels rather than a single register: a five-language telephone service (영어·중국어·일본어·베트남어·몽골어), an English SMS channel, multilingual content planned for the city's own Instagram and blog channels, AI real-time interpretation at eleven major subway stations, multilingual tourist information on VISIT SEOUL, and 생활상담 at 서울글로벌센터.
value.event_implication: For a private community event this is guidance, not an obligation: the city publishes no rule requiring a private event to use any particular language. Providing Korean copy with an English version follows the city's own practice and matches how the city answers a non-Korean-speaking resident.
value.not_established: The release sets no obligation on a private event's language, gives no figure for how many Seoul residents read each language, and says nothing about interpretation, signage or accessibility obligations at a hired venue.
value.published_channels: The quoted release names the five telephone languages, the English SMS line (02-120, weekdays 09:00-18:00), the plan to post multilingual content on the city-run Instagram and blog, AI interpretation at eleven stations, VISIT SEOUL's multilingual pages and 서울글로벌센터 counselling.

evidence.inference: The previous Seoul run scored this building as its top venue on a main-hall price that is no longer published; today the only readable price is the sub-room hourly rate and the 70-person line is not tied to a specific room, so the record is priced on the sub-room estimate with the room question carried as material.
evidence.observed_facts: The venue's own pricing page (mongsang-space.com/pricing, fetched 2026-11-28) prints '서브 세미나룸 평일 44,000원/h (월-목), 주말 55,000원/h (금요일, 공휴일 포함)', a catering service from 10,000 KRW per person, and a use note '최대 70인 이용 가능 (사전 문의 필수)' together with '음식물 및 주류 반입시 별도 협의 필수'. The home page states the space is in 문래동, has full soundproofing, unlimited parking, is five minutes on foot from a subway station, and provides a screen, beam projector and prompters for presentations; the footer address is 서울특별시 영등포구 문래북로8 에이스NS타워 B102호. USD: ECB 2026-11-27 (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65), 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912; 55,000 KRW = USD 41.2016 per hour, 8 hours = USD 329.61.

verification_questions: Confirm the rental fee for 컨퍼런스 B룸 (60 seats): the reservation page lists rooms and capacities but the fee table is only rendered after a date is selected, and no static rate is published.
Confirm whether the 09:00-18:00 band can be extended to 21:00 by adding the 19:00-22:00 night band, and what the combined price is.
Confirm AV and Wi-Fi: the centre's marketing describes premium lecture rooms but the Samsung centre page captured today does not itemise equipment.
Confirm a 2027 Saturday booking (the page states weekend and holiday inquiries are answered on the next business day).

Confirm the alcohol rule for the room: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it - no venue page in this set publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, and a cafe or restaurant licence is not evidence for the hall.

evidence.inference: Capacity 110 is the operator's own stated figure and the LED wall plus sound console make the room the strongest recording fit in the DDP set, but the 10:00 opening means the brief's 09:00-21:00 window is not available - the record is priced on the printed 11-hour day and the missing 09:00 hour is carried as an availability question rather than assumed.
evidence.observed_facts: The DDP rental page (ddp.or.kr/?menuno=725, fetched 2026-11-28) lists the Design Lab 3F Design Hall at 627.6 m2 with '수용인원 약 110명' and a fee table of 296,000 KRW per hour, 888,000 KRW for 3 hours and 3,256,000 KRW for one day; the DDP 대관정보서비스 Design Lab page (deep.ddp.or.kr/introduce/c003.do, fetched 2026-11-28) prints the '대관 가능 시간' table, whose '기타 시설' row gives '10:00 ~ 21:00 (11시간)', with an overrun charge of 150% of the base rate per hour. The DDP Organizer Guide PDF (ddp.or.kr/file/attach/DDP_EVENT_GUIDE2.pdf, fetched 2026-11-28) gives the room's equipment as a 6.4m x 4m LED display, an LS9 console with d&b 12S speakers and Shure radio microphones, HDMI laptop connection, tiered seating for about 30 and about 80 chairs, and repeats '수용능력 - 약 110명'. The same guide states Design Lab food brought in requires prior consultation, and the rental notice on deep.ddp.or.kr states internet use must be applied for separately. Address 281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04566. USD basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65), giving 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912; 3,256,000 KRW = USD 2,439.13.

seoul-384cd72e7d96.name: DDP 동대문디자인플라자 — 디자인랩 디자인홀 (Design Hall, 3F)
verification_questions: Confirm Wi-Fi for a 50-person event: the DDP rental notice states internet use must be applied for separately by the applicant, and the Design Hall page lists no included network.

Confirm a 2027 Saturday in the Design Lab: the base window is 10:00-21:00, so a 09:00 start is not available and the 12-hour 09:00-21:00 brief cannot be met - confirm the 10:00-21:00 (11-hour) window instead.
Confirm whether the printed 3,256,000 KRW one-day rate is VAT-inclusive and whether the 3-hour/1-day rate table applies to Saturday without a weekend surcharge.
Confirm AV operation: the hall includes a 6.4m x 4m LED display, an LS9 console and d&b speakers, but the guide does not state whether an operator is included in the room rate.

Confirm the alcohol rule for the room: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it - no venue page in this set publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, and a cafe or restaurant licence is not evidence for the hall.

evidence.inference: A 456-seat concert hall is oversized for 50 people, and the redevelopment notice makes 2027 availability genuinely uncertain; it is retained because the price and technical package are published and it is the only riverside/performance option in the set.
evidence.observed_facts: The Nodeul Island livehouse page (nodeul.org/facility/livehouse/, fetched 2026-11-28) prints 1,320 m2, 456 designated seats or 708 standing, a 10:00-23:00 performance rental window (10:00-22:00 for preparation), and weekend/public-holiday rates of 4,000,000 KRW for one performance and 6,000,000 KRW for two, VAT excluded; the rate includes sound, lighting and instruments, one house manager and four ushers, dressing rooms, lobby and ticket booth. The rental guide (nodeul.org/rent-guide/, fetched 2026-11-28) states the 2026 second-half open call runs only to 2026-10-31 and that schedules may change under the Nodeul Global Art Island project, and requires applications at least four weeks before the event. verification_questions: Confirm AV: the shared-facility record lists no projector, screen, microphone or Wi-Fi, so all presentation equipment must be assumed to be brought in.
Confirm a 2027 Saturday booking and the reservation window, which the record describes as opening on the first day of each month.
Confirm the capacity rule: the record states '최대 50명(권장)~100명 이내' and places safety responsibility on the organiser, so confirm that 50 attendees are accepted and what fire-safety limit applies.
Confirm that the 30,000 KRW two-hour rate (VAT excluded) can be booked as five consecutive blocks for a 10-hour day and what the overrun charge is.

Confirm the alcohol rule for the room: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it - no venue page in this set publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, and a cafe or restaurant licence is not evidence for the hall.

evidence.inference: The stated 150-200 range is a flat-floor capacity; 150 is recorded as the conservative end. This is the only DDP room whose guide text states catering is supported, which is why it scores better on catering than the Design Hall despite having no listed screen.
evidence.observed_facts: The DDP rental page (ddp.or.kr/?menuno=725, fetched 2026-11-28) lists the Design Lab 4F Jandi-sarangbang at 570 m2 with a fee of 271,660 KRW per hour, 814,980 KRW for 3 hours and 2,988,000 KRW per day. The DDP Organizer Guide PDF (ddp.or.kr/file/attach/DDP_EVENT_GUIDE2.pdf, fetched 2026-11-28) states the room is 570 m2, 41.0m x 25.5m, 5.5m maximum height, '수용능력 약150~200명', and that its attached facilities allow catering and food-and-drink events; it also connects directly to the grass hill above Dongdaemun History and Culture Park. Address 281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04566. USD basis: ECB 2026-11-27 rates fetched 2026-11-28 (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65), 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912; 2,988,000 KRW = USD 2,238.37. verification_questions: Confirm whether a 2027 Saturday can be booked: the page prints weekday consultation hours (10:00-16:00) and four-hour blocks, but does not state weekend availability.
Confirm the approval route and lead time - bookings go through the Gyeonggi sharing service with manager review within three days and prepayment within 14 days.

Confirm the alcohol rule for the room: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it - no venue page in this set publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, and a cafe or restaurant licence is not evidence for the hall.

evidence.inference: The studio's own description is broadcast-first, but the guide explicitly allows talk shows and forums and states an 80-person capacity, so it is recorded as an event room with the strongest recording evidence in the set; the seated layout and the operator question are carried as verification.
evidence.observed_facts: The DDP rental page (ddp.or.kr/?menuno=725, fetched 2026-11-28) lists the 2F Seoul-On video studio at 378.22 m2 with 241,000 KRW per hour, 723,000 KRW for 3 hours and 2,651,000 KRW per day. The DDP Organizer Guide (ddp.or.kr/file/attach/DDP_EVENT_GUIDE2.pdf, fetched 2026-11-28) states the studio holds up to 80 people, has a 35m-long LED display (21m fixed plus a 14m movable section), a 4K-capable production chain, a Dante audio network, broadcast lighting, an intercom/translation room, VIP waiting room and lounge, and that talk shows, forums and lectures can be held there. The same guide gives the conference room next door a capacity of about 20. Address 281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04566. USD: ECB 2026-11-27 (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65), 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912; 2,651,000 KRW = USD 1,985.92. The DDP 대관정보서비스 Design Lab page (deep.ddp.or.kr/introduce/c003.do, fetched 2026-11-28) prints the '대관 가능 시간' table, whose rows read '컨벤션' / '08:00 ~ 20:00 (12시간)', '전시관(뮤지엄) · 갤러리문 · 이간수문전시장' / '10:00 ~ 21:00 (11시간)' and '기타 시설' / '10:00 ~ 21:00 (11시간)', with overruns at 150% of the base rate, and repeats the 디자인랩 대관료 table that prices this room.
